summary: Constructor for an audio-stream list manager. Zero-initializes the eight list fields (this[0..7], offsets 0x0-0x1C), allocates a 4-byte node wrapper and a 620-byte stream-manager buffer via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, runs NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH_a6eb to construct two 308-byte audio stream objects using AudioStreamConstructWithVTableInit and SingleVTablePointerSet, appends the wrapper to list1 with LinkedListNodeAppend_6000, and pre-allocates two empty 308-byte nodes into list2 with LinkedListNodeAllocPrepend. Finishes by zeroing this[8] and byte this+40, setting this[9] to -1, and creating a mutex with CreateMutexA stored at this[8]; the flag byte at this+40 is set to 1 only when the mutex handle is non-null.

operations.description: Zero-initialize the eight dword list fields this[0] through this[7] (offsets 0x0-0x1C): two heads, two tails, two cursors and two element counts.
Allocate the 4-byte node wrapper with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper; a local guard variable tracks the construction stage for the SEH frame (handler SEH_581D40) unwind cleanup.
Allocate the 620-byte stream-manager buffer with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper; allocation failure leaves the wrapper node's link null.

Initialize the buffer header (*v3 = 2) and construct two 308-byte audio stream objects via NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH_a6eb using AudioStreamConstructWithVTableInit as the constructor callback and SingleVTablePointerSet as the vtable setup callback.
Link the constructed stream buffer pointer into the wrapper node (the 4-byte allocation's first dword).
Append the wrapper node to list1 with LinkedListNodeAppend_6000(node, 1).
Pre-allocate two empty nodes into list2 with LinkedListNodeAllocPrepend for i in 0..616 stepping 308, positioning each at i plus the wrapper base.
Reset the mutex-handle field this[8] (offset 0x20) and the initialized-flag byte this+40 (offset 0x28) to 0, and set this[9] (offset 0x24) to -1 before mutex creation.

Create a mutex with CreateMutexA using a SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES configured with nLength 12, null security descriptor and inheritable handle, no owner and no name; store the returned handle at this[8] (offset 0x20).
Mark the object initialized: set the flag byte at offset 0x28 to 1 only when the mutex handle is non-null; otherwise the object stays in the not-initialized state.
Return this (the manager object) from all paths.

unresolved: Three byte_FF0000000000545x globals are reported as written but never appear as named operands in the decompiled body; they are likely IDA artifacts of the SEH frame (the LOBYTE(v12) stage writes), and their bit-level mapping is not established.

The role split between the 4-byte wrapper node and the 620-byte manager buffer (two linked lists sharing one node) is inferred from LinkedListNodeAppend_6000 and LinkedListNodeAllocPrepend usage, not confirmed statically.
The 308-byte stride and count 2 for NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH_a6eb are taken verbatim from the raw source; the per-object layout inside the 620-byte buffer is not reconstructed here.
